title: Tenses in Stories and Reports
ringkas: Konsistensi tense, cerita, laporan, ujaran tidak langsung, dan conditional
goals: menjaga **konsistensi tense** dalam cerita, email, dan laporan
memakai tense yang tepat untuk **narasi**, **berita**, dan **laporan data**
mengubah tense pada **ujaran tidak langsung** (reported speech)

lesson.text: Sampai sini kamu sudah mengenal tiap tense. Sekarang kita lihat bagaimana tense bekerja **bersama-sama** di teks nyata: cerita, laporan, ujaran tidak langsung, dan kalimat bersyarat. Aturan utamanya: **pilih satu 'waktu utama' lalu jaga konsistensinya**.

lesson.title: 1. Konsistensi dalam teks
table: [[Yesterday I woke up late. It was raining, so I took a taxi.]]
[[I wake up at six. I take a bus.]]
[[A fire has destroyed a market. Police said it started at nine.]]
[[Sales rose by 10%. This shows that demand is growing.]]

lesson.title: 2. Berpindah tense dengan alasan
lesson.text: Tense boleh berpindah jika waktunya memang berpindah:
table: [[She told me that water boils at 100 degrees.]]
[[I was tired because I had slept badly.]]
[[I live in Bali. I have lived here for years.]]

lesson.title: 3. Reported speech: mundur satu langkah
table: past simple → [[She said she was tired.]]
past continuous → [[He said he was working.]]
past perfect → [[She said she had gone.]]
past perfect → [[He said he had finished.]]

lesson.title: 4. Tense dan conditional
table: [[If I were rich, I would travel.]]
if + past perfect, would have + V3
[[If I had known, I would have come.]]

lesson.title: Cek konsistensi saat menulis
lesson.text: Setelah menulis satu paragraf, baca ulang hanya **kata kerjanya**. Apakah semuanya mengikuti waktu utama? Jika ada yang berbeda, pastikan perpindahannya punya alasan.

practice.q: Pilih paragraf yang konsisten:
options: Yesterday I woke up late. It was raining, so I took a taxi.
Yesterday I wake up late. It rains, so I took a taxi.
Yesterday I woke up late. It is raining, so I take a taxi.
Yesterday I wake up late. It was raining, so I take a taxi.
practice.exp: Past semua. Jawaban yang tepat: **Yesterday I woke up late. It was raining, so I took a taxi.**

practice.q: Pilih tense yang tepat (cerita): "Last night, I ___ home and cooked dinner."
Pilih tense yang tepat (kebiasaan): "Every morning, I ___ at six."
practice.exp: Kebiasaan. Kalimat lengkap: **Every morning, I wake up at six.**

practice.q: Pilih bentuk yang benar (berita): "A fire ___ a market this morning."
Pilih bentuk yang benar (laporan): "Sales ___ by 10% last month."
Ubah ke ujaran tidak langsung: "I am tired," she said. → She said she ___ tired.
Ubah: "I went home," he said. → He said he ___ gone home.
Ubah: "I will call you," she said. → She said she ___ call me.
Ubah: "I have finished," he said. → He said he ___ finished.
Ubah: "I am working," she said. → She said she ___ working.
Pilih bentuk yang benar (type 1): "If it rains, I ___ stay home."
practice.exp: Conditional type 1: if + present simple, ... will + kata kerja dasar. Kalimat lengkap: **If it rains, I will stay home.**

practice.q: Pilih bentuk yang benar (type 2): "If I were rich, I ___ travel."
practice.exp: Conditional type 2: if + past simple, ... would + kata kerja dasar. Kalimat lengkap: **If I were rich, I would travel.**

practice.q: Pilih bentuk yang benar (type 3): "If I had known, I ___ come."
practice.exp: Conditional type 3: if + past perfect, ... would have + V3. Kalimat lengkap: **If I had known, I would have come.**

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH:
options: Yesterday I wake up late and took a taxi.
Yesterday I woke up late and took a taxi.
I wake up late and take a taxi.
I woke up late and took a taxi.
practice.exp: Konsisten. Jawaban yang tepat: **Yesterday I wake up late and took a taxi.**

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH:
options: She said she will call me.
She said she would call me.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH:
options: If it will rain, I will stay.
If it rains, I will stay.
If it rained, I would stay.
If it had rained, I would have stayed.

practice.q: Yesterday I ___ up late. (wake)
She said she ___ tired. (be)
She said she ___ call me.
He said he ___ finished. (have)

practice.id: Kalau hujan, aku akan tinggal di rumah.
practice.q: If it rains, I ___ stay home.
practice.exp: Conditional type 1: if + present simple, ... will + kata kerja dasar. Jawaban yang tepat: **will**.

practice.id: Seandainya aku tahu, aku sudah datang.
practice.q: If I had known, I would ___ come.
practice.exp: Conditional type 3: if + past perfect, ... would have + V3. Jawaban yang tepat: **have**.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Kemarin aku bangun kesiangan dan naik taksi."
practice.answer: Yesterday I woke up late and took a taxi.
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: Yesterday I woke up late and took a taxi.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Dia bilang dia akan menelepon."
practice.answer: She said she would call me.
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: She said she would call me.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Kalau hujan, aku akan tinggal di rumah."
practice.answer: If it rains, I will stay home.
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: If it rains, I will stay home.

options: I woke up at six. I took a bath and ate breakfast.
I woke up at six. I take a bath and ate breakfast.
I wake up at six. I took a bath and eat breakfast.
I wake up at six. I took a bath and eaten breakfast.
quiz.exp: Past semua. Jawaban yang tepat: **I woke up at six. I took a bath and ate breakfast.**

quiz.q: Ubah: "We are late," they said. → They said they ___ late.
Ubah: "I can swim," she said. → She said she ___ swim.
Pilih bentuk yang benar (berita): "The police ___ that two people were hurt."
Pilih bentuk yang benar (type 2): "If I had more time, I ___ help you."
quiz.exp: Conditional type 2: if + past simple, ... would + kata kerja dasar. Kalimat lengkap: **If I had more time, I would help you.**
has → had. Jawaban yang tepat: **He said he has finished.**

options: If I would be rich, I would travel.
If I were rich, I would travel.
If I had money, I would travel.
If I had been rich, I would have traveled.
She told me that water boils at 100 degrees.
She told me that water boiled at 100 degree.
She told me that water boiling at 100 degrees.
She told me that water has boil.

quiz.exp: Kejadian sudah selesai, jadi memakai past simple. Jawaban yang tepat: **went**.

quiz.id: Kalau aku kaya, aku akan bepergian.
quiz.q: If I were rich, I ___ travel.
quiz.exp: Conditional type 2: if + past simple, ... would + kata kerja dasar. Jawaban yang tepat: **would**.

read.id:
Reporter: Kebakaran menghancurkan pasar tadi malam.
Officer: Api mulai pukul sembilan. Pada tengah malam, petugas pemadam sudah memadamkannya.
Reporter: Apa kata pemiliknya?
Officer: Dia bilang dia sangat sedih. Dia bilang dia akan membangun kembali tokonya.
Reporter: Dan apa yang terjadi berikutnya?
Officer: Kalau cuaca tetap kering, pembersihan akan selesai pada hari Jumat.

qs.exp: Officer: "He said he would rebuild his shop".
qs.q: What did the owner say he would do?

options: He said he will rebuild his shop.
He said he would rebuild his shop.
The firefighters had put it out.

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "The fire ___ at nine."
By midnight, the firefighters ___ put it out.
If the weather stays dry, the cleanup ___ finish by Friday.

qs.answer: He said he was very sad.
qs.exp: Urutan: He said he was very sad.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dia bilang dia sangat sedih."

read.text:
Reporter: A fire destroyed the market last night.
Officer: The fire started at nine. By midnight, the firefighters had put it out.
Reporter: What did the owner say?
Officer: He said he was very sad. He said he would rebuild his shop.
Reporter: And what will happen next?
Officer: If the weather stays dry, the cleanup will finish by Friday.
read.title: News and Reports

read.id: Badai kuat menghantam pantai pada Selasa malam. Angin bertiup delapan puluh kilometer per jam, dan banyak pohon tumbang. Pada tengah malam, hujan telah membanjiri beberapa jalan. Wali kota mengatakan bahwa kota akan membuka tempat penampungan. Petugas mengatakan bahwa warga sebaiknya tetap di dalam rumah. Kalau hujan berlanjut, banjir akan memburuk. Pembersihan diperkirakan selesai pada Jumat depan.

qs.q: What did the mayor say the city would do?

options: The mayor said that the city will open shelters.
The mayor said that the city would open shelters.
By midnight, the rain had flooded several streets.
If the rain continues, the flood will get worse.

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "The wind ___ at eighty kilometers an hour."
By midnight, the rain ___ flooded several streets.
If the rain continues, the flood ___ get worse.

qs.answer: A strong storm hit the coast on Tuesday night.
qs.exp: Urutan: A strong storm hit the coast on Tuesday night.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Badai kuat menghantam pantai pada Selasa malam."

read.text: A strong storm hit the coast on Tuesday night. The wind blew at eighty kilometers an hour, and many trees fell. By midnight, the rain had flooded several streets. The mayor said that the city would open shelters. Officials said that residents should stay indoors. If the rain continues, the flood will get worse. The cleanup is expected to finish by next Friday.
read.title: Storm Report

Dina: Apakah kamu berbicara dengan manajer?
Tom: Ya. Dia bilang rapat akan dimulai pukul sepuluh.
Dina: Apa lagi yang dia katakan?
Tom: Dia memberitahuku bahwa penjualan naik sepuluh persen.
Dina: Kabar baik! Apakah dia menyebut bonus?
Tom: Dia bilang kalau kita mencapai target, kita akan mendapatkannya.

qs.exp: Tom: "the meeting would start at ten".
qs.q: What did the manager say would start at ten?

options: He said that the meeting will start at ten.
He said that the meeting would start at ten.
He told me that sales had increased.
If we reached the target, we would get one.

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "He said the meeting ___ start at ten."
He told me that sales ___ increased.
If we reached the target, we ___ get a bonus.

qs.answer: He said that the meeting would start at ten.
qs.exp: Urutan: He said that the meeting would start at ten.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dia bilang rapat akan dimulai pukul sepuluh."

read.text:
Dina: Did you talk to the manager?
Tom: Yes. He said that the meeting would start at ten.
Dina: What else did he say?
Tom: He told me that sales had increased by ten percent.
Dina: Good news! Did he mention the bonus?
Tom: He said that if we reached the target, we would get one.
read.title: Reported Conversation
